I haven't placed the order yet because I can't tell which monitor the design team standardised on.

**Docks are sorted:** the new DK-200 is in stock (10 available, $189 each), so I'd order 3 of those. I'd skip the refurbished DK-200-R, and the DK-210 successor isn't needed.

**The monitor needs your answer.** Two new monitors are in stock, and nothing in the catalog or past orders shows which one the design team chose. There are no previous orders to go on.

| Option | Monitor | Unit price | Order total (3 × DK-200 + 3 monitors) |
|---|---|---|---|
| MN-27 | 27-inch 4K | $329 | $1,554 |
| MN-32 | 32-inch 5K | $529 | $2,154 |

Either way, the total is under the $2,500 limit, so the order won't need manager approval. Tell me which monitor and I'll place it as a single order to HQ with the primary supplier.

trace.message: The design team standardised on the 32-inch MN-32 monitor.
